coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 10 of 17 ground-truth variable items (59%): train/validation/test splits, input window length, forecast horizon, cycle length, model type, input/output dimensions, synthetic-data parameters, normalization, MSE, and MAE. Relevant information was extracted from the Spanish narrative.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses AdamW rather than the specified Adam setup and CPU resources rather than an RTX 4090. Omits the RevIN flag, 30-epoch training setting, batch size, cycle-index generation method, and visualization outputs. Period estimation is described, but it does not specify how cycle indices are generated.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Does not report a trained CycleNet capable of accurate forecasting or visualizations of historical data, ground truth, predictions, and learned cyclic patterns.
